name: Phyrexianized elementals
description: Zendikar's guardian elementals, converted into oil-covered Phyrexian zealots in the Skyclave.

timeline.summary: The party kills a corrupted tree elemental, and Orah's fingers are covered in black oil.
timeline.quote: The tips of his fingers are covered in a sickly black oil.

timeline.summary: Surrounded by Phyrexianized elementals, the party is saved when Linvala's light parts the elementals and reveals a door.
timeline.quote: Tazri looks and sees Linvala radiating with light and charging forward.

timeline.summary: In flashback, Nahiri recounts converting or killing the elementals and pouring her joy, anger and grief into the hedron network until nothing is left.
timeline.quote: So, she channeled her pain, her grief from the betrayals, the losses, the loneliness over the millennia.

pages_say.description: Zendikar's guardian elementals, converted into oil-covered Phyrexian zealots in the Skyclave.
